result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers use heavy weights, tabular-looking times, strikethrough on cancelled rows, and status words with icons, so they suit bright-sun reading about equally. B wins because its phone number is clearly visible, large and set in high-contrast, unambiguous digits; in A's screenshot the phone number is cut off, so it can't be checked. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both pages use bold system sans with times that line up in tabular columns, heavy weights and a strong yellow alert banner, so they read well on a phone in sun. However, B's phone number is cut off in the screenshot and can't be checked, while A's is large, high-contrast and clearly tappable.
